competitor.label: rfcxml-mcp, the most active RFC server

tasks.prompt: RFC 2616 defined HTTP/1.1. Which RFCs replace it today (the current documents, not intermediate ones)? Give the RFC numbers only.
Is RFC 7231 still the current specification? Answer yes or no.
What is the title of section 15.5.5 of RFC 9110? Give only the title.
According to the IANA HTTP Status Code registry, what is status code 418 registered as today? Give the registry description only.
Which RFC defines the media type application/json according to IANA? Give the RFC number only.
Which service is registered with IANA on port 5432? Give only the service name.
Which RFCs make up BCP 14? Give the RFC numbers only.
Is there a verified technical erratum for RFC 9110 section 12.5.1? If so, give its errata id only.
Which RFC was draft-ietf-httpbis-semantics published as? Give the RFC number only.
What is the IANA value of the TLS cipher suite TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256? Give it exactly as IANA writes it.
